title: Joining George Lewis's band
summary: After sitting in with Eddie Morris and Lewis, Watkins is offered regular work because of his old style of playing.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And he needed a drummer and he told Slowdrag to see if Slowdrag could get in touch with me. Yeah. And told me to come out there.
So I went on out there and I played with him. And in the meantime Slowdrag came back and asked if I had got home.
My wife told him no I had knocked off. And he said well as soon as he come home, tell him that George wants him to play with him tonight right at the corner from my house.

So sure enough when I got home she gave me a message and I went on out there and all us George, Lawrence, Drag and myself, four of us, we played a house party there for them. Yeah. Some white people that lived right at the corner from Drag's house. The following week George had another job for me playing at the St. Mary's Church front out there. We played that. The following week he had a job to play an advertising for a prize fight back at Pelican

So that night he told me, he said, George, how would you like to work regularly with me? He said I'll get in the playing of work. I said well, I said George I'll tell you. I've been off these things so long and I'm trying to get back into them. He said well I think you're doing nicely. He said I want you to play with me, he said because you've got that old style of playing that I like. He said because I'm not going to change the none of this modern stuff they're playing. He said I'm holding on to the authentic. And they said you play the authentic drums? I said yeah I want. Yeah. So from then on I was playing all the jobs with him. Yeah. We went back to his hard out at Manus Tavern back on Benefit and St. Rock. We played out there, oh I forgot how many years, on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights. Well that's where a lot of the people from in town was coming back at, back there after they heard about George Lewis where he was playing every weekend. So from there Nick Gagliano had taken over the band.
